keyEvents.text: Goal! Barcelona 0, Villarreal 1. Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Barcelona 0, Villarreal 2. Tani Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Alberto Moleiro following a fast break.
Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty missed! Still Barcelona 0, Villarreal 2. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) hits the right post with a left footed shot.
Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Barcelona 0, Villarreal 2.
Second Half begins Barcelona 0, Villarreal 2.
Pau Navarro (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alex Freeman (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Barcelona 1, Villarreal 2. Gerard Martín (Barcelona) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Pedri with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Barcelona 2, Villarreal 2. Fermín López (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lamine Yamal.
Carlos Romero (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Villarreal. Carlos Maciá replaces Alberto Moleiro.
Substitution, Villarreal. Sergi Cardona replaces Carlos Romero.
Own Goal by Pau Navarro, Villarreal. Barcelona 3, Villarreal 2.
Substitution, Barcelona. Anthony Gordon replaces Karim Adeyemi.
Substitution, Barcelona. Dani Olmo replaces Fermín López.
Raphinha (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Villarreal. Nicolas Pepe replaces Santi Comesaña.
Substitution, Villarreal. Ayoze Pérez replaces Tajon Buchanan.
Marc Bernal (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Barcelona. Jules Koundé replaces Eric García.
Substitution, Villarreal. Santiago Mouriño replaces Georges Mikautadze.
Delay in match because of an injury Marc Bernal (Barcelona).
Substitution, Barcelona. Gavi replaces Marc Bernal because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second yellow card to Pau Navarro (Villarreal) for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Barcelona 3, Villarreal 2.

commentary.text: Goal! Barcelona 0, Villarreal 1. Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner.
